verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents a Get Filings API that lists filings filtered by dates, jurisdiction and status, plus per-registration filing retrieval, so per-filing status is visible. The docs also state it files and remits on schedule. Nothing in the pack shows a calendar of upcoming returns, remitted amounts, or downloadable confirmations. Missing for 10: calendar view of upcoming returns, documented remitted amounts per filing, downloadable filing confirmations, ops-facing UI dashboard evidence, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can see the whole filing picture — a calendar of upcoming returns, per-filing status, the amounts remitted, and downloadable confirmations for every return submitted

citations.quote: The Get Filings API retrieves a paginated list of filings based on filters such as dates, jurisdiction, Country, status, etc.
The Get Filings By Registration ID API retrieves all filings associated with a specific registration ID.
